title: A Planeswalker's Guide to Zendikar: Murasa and Sejiri

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane whose continents Murasa and the subpolar cap Sejiri are described in this guide.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: An island continent of Zendikar, a vast steep-walled plateau hiding diverse environments behind sheer stony cliffs.

entities.name: Sunder Cove
entities.description: The largest break in Murasa's wall, an enormous tide-wracked bay clotted by massive harabaz trees.

entities.name: Cliffs of Kazuul
entities.description: The only maintained cliff-side ascent of Murasa's Wall, ruled by an ogre slave-master who demands tribute.

entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: An ogre slave-master who rules the Cliffs of Kazuul and demands tribute from those seeking passage.

entities.name: Thunder Gap
entities.description: A canyon passage along the Vazi River into Murasa's interior, once well kept but now haunted after the kor were found slain.

entities.name: Pillar Plains
entities.description: A section of Murasa's Wall cracked into thousands of pillars, once home to a clan of herding kor.

entities.name: Glint Pass
entities.description: A cave passage under the east side of Murasa's Wall lit by flame-quartz, leading to a vampire-held structure.

entities.name: Cipher in Flames
entities.description: A fabled ever-burning glyph in the Glint Pass said to enable a ritual of transport anywhere in the world.

entities.name: Skyfang Mountains
entities.description: Forested mountains in western Murasa with floating stalactite-like fangs that fall when sunlight is blocked.

entities.name: Na Plateau
entities.description: A quarter-mile-high forested plateau in Murasa where wurms and goblin tribes dwell.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: A ruin on the Na Plateau named for eerie music from its underground chambers, which drives explorers mad.

entities.name: Kazandu
entities.description: A broken landscape of canyons dominated by jaddi trees and the seat of the Kazandu Splinter.

entities.name: Kazandu Splinter
entities.description: A group of elves who dissociated from the larger Tajuru nation and hold Kazandu.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: An elf tribe that set up the flags and beacons in Sunder Cove and the Cliffs of Kazuul.

entities.name: Sejiri
entities.description: Zendikar's subpolar cap, an icy wind-blasted tundra mesa with few settlements.

entities.name: Midnight Pass
entities.description: The only way to reach Sejiri other than climbing, a narrow dark sea pass between cliffs.

entities.name: Ikiral
entities.description: A settlement and trading post in the split ruins of a toppled hedron in Sejiri.

entities.name: Aida Lunda
entities.description: An explorer whose journal tells of the Singing City's notes and the influence of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Anitan
entities.description: An Ondu cleric who records encountering kor ghosts in Thunder Gap.

entities.name: Mkema Leatherfoot
entities.description: An explorer who has repeatedly mapped and returned to Kazandu.

entities.name: Jalaradi
entities.description: An Ikiral outrider who sailed to Sejiri eight years earlier and came to love it.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings whose influence Aida Lunda feels strongly in the Singing City.

events.summary: Two decades earlier the kor of Thunder Gap were found slain, hung from their own hooked lines; the trail has gone unmaintained and is said to be haunted.
events.quote: But two decades ago, something happened to the kor.

events.summary: Anitan's party awakens tortured kor ghosts in Thunder Gap.
events.quote: We know we have awakened guardians from some far realm, but we do not know how to calm or free their bound souls.

events.summary: Aida Lunda plans to journey into the heart of the Singing City, hoping to learn the Eldrazi message.
events.quote: I can feel a breakthrough coming.

events.summary: The Tajuru elves and merfolk mark a safe route through the harabaz forest and rescue survivors from wrecked ships.
events.quote: Sometimes the elves are able to spot sundered ships and reach them in time to save a few crew

events.summary: Those who reach the top of the Cliffs of Kazuul without paying tribute are cast out, sometimes hurled to their deaths.
events.quote: Those who reach the top without proper tribute for Kazuul are cast out

events.summary: Mkema Leatherfoot recounts losing allies and finding artifacts in repeated expeditions to Kazandu.
events.quote: I have lost friends and allies to its treacherous broken cliffs.

events.summary: Jalaradi recounts sailing to Sejiri eight years ago against everyone's advice and adapting to the tundra.
events.quote: I sailed here eight years ago, unpaid, in the long dark of the blizzard season, against the passionate arguments of everyone I knew.

relations.quote: the Cliffs of Kazuul are named for the pass's current ruler, an ogre slave-master who demands tribute from any who seek passage
Although smaller than other continents of Zendikar, Murasa conceals an incredible diversity of environments

relations.note: Elves who dissociated from the larger Tajuru nation
relations.quote: a group of elves who have dissociated themselves from the larger Tajuru nation, known as the Kazandu Splinter
Outposts in Sejiri are few and far between, but in the ruins of a massive stone monolith huddles the settlement and trading post called Ikiral.
